engine.interop: Dedicated decoder/presenter devices; target-only GPU NV12 copy + BT.709 shader to reusable shared BGRA; keyed mutex + D3D11 fence event; no CPU pixel readback
engine.decoderDpb: FFmpeg-owned per decoder; current plus next clip decoder
engine.resourceDefinition: BGRA counts/bytes are actual application allocations including old decoder cache/presenter references. DPB counts are FFmpeg declared capacities observed on decoded frames, not measured driver VRAM. NV12 scratch, swapchains and driver overhead are separate. No proxy; full source resolution decoded.
engine.readinessNotification: GPU fence event -> immediate frame publication -> independent presenter/coordinator events; resident seek hit publishes on control owner
engine.lateDefinition: Unique missing containing frames at advancing presentation ticks; excludes seek preparation, gap/startup/UI queries and repeated ticks for the same frame
engine.staleDefinition: Sum of rejected old-generation requests, rejected Present receipts, cancelled target decodes and cancelled optional prefetch decodes; NOT IDR prefix frames or visible drops
